name: secrets
description: Secrets for ai-gent in pass (the standard Unix password manager): entries under ai-gent/<area>/<name>, read only by the runner that needs them, never shown to the agent — with a guard that keeps secret values out of the conversation

secretMask.title: Mask pasted secrets
secretMask.description: Mask credentials pasted into a prompt, a slash command's arguments or a skill's body before they are recorded or sent, and say where to keep them (pass)

maskAssignments.title: Mask NAME=value secrets
maskAssignments.description: Also mask PASSWORD=..., TOKEN: ... style assignments in prompts and command arguments (they can catch prose; turn off to keep only keys, tokens, auth headers and URL passwords)

guardUx.title: Explain this guard's decisions
guardUx.description: When the guard denies or asks, say why in plain words and what to do instead (the guard still decides; this changes only the words)

secretOutputWarning.title: Warn about secrets in tool output
secretOutputWarning.description: When a tool's result holds a credential (a key, a token, a private key, a URL password), say so, what to rotate and where to keep the new one (pass)

secretOutputRedact.title: Redact secrets in tool output
secretOutputRedact.description: Replace the credential in the result of the tools listed below with a placeholder in what Claude reads and the transcript keeps; off means warn only. The screen may still show the original, so treat the value as exposed

secretOutputTools.title: Tools whose output is redacted
secretOutputTools.description: Comma-separated tool names redacted when their result holds a credential; any other tool is warned about and left as it is. Adding Read or Grep risks a placeholder being written back into a file
